FCA verkündet Rekordumsatz | Mitgliederversammlung in der WWK ARENA
FC Augsburg
30500 subscribers

Am Dienstagabend veranstaltete der Fußball-Club Augsburg 1907 e. V. seine ordentliche Mitgliederversammlung. Vor über 900 Vereinsmitgliedern konnte der FCA einen Rekordumsatz vermelden. Erstmals kratzte der Klub dabei an der 150-Millionen-Euro-Marke. Zudem gehören nun 30.660 Mitglieder dem Verein an.

Posted byThe Soccer TavernPosted inGerman Club HistoryTags:1860 München, Abdul Rahman Baba, Armin Veh, Bernd Schuster, Bundesliga, Crest, Daniel Baier, Die Fuggerstädter, FC Augsburg, FC Ingolstadt, Football, Founding Story, Fußball-Club Augsburg 1907, Fugger City, Futbol, Helmut Haller, history, Jos Luhukay, Karl-Heinz Riedle, manager, Martin Hinteregger, Michael Thurk, nickname, Origin, Records, rival, Rosenaustadion, Soccer, Statistics, Stats, WWK Arena. *Welcome to the Soccer Tavern, where we’re discussing the history, philosophy, and culture of the beautiful game. My name is Dave and in this video, we’re talking about the history of Fußball-Club Augsburg 1907 e. FC Augsburg is located in the southern part of the city of Augsburg. Over the course of the year, more and more men kept showing up to play, so on August 8, 1907, a club was officially formed named FC Alemmania. As a result of this final merger, the club officially became its current name of Fußball-Club Augsburg 1907 e. It’s also a general nickname for people from the city of Augsburg.
